listings.description:
Written by Tony Award-winning playwright Rupert Holmes, starring Michelle Azar as Ruth Bader Ginsburg, directed by Laley Lippard.

Justice "RBG" welcomes a family friend into her chambers for ninety funny, fascinating minutes tracing her extraordinary life: losing her mother the day before her high school valedictory, studying law at Harvard as one of just nine women while raising a daughter and supporting a husband battling cancer, fighting sexist courts in the 1970s, and standing firm as a voice of reason on an increasingly divided Supreme Court.

Now Lawrence honors Rachlin's memory with a solo violin recital, a program of cheerful humor, blazing virtuosity, and the sublime transcendence of Bach's Partita in D minor, with the Chaconne. Malian master kora player Ballaké Sissoko was last on our stage with the French cellist Vincent Ségal for a sold-out concert in 2017. This consummate musical collaborator is now touring with the British singer/guitarist (and visual artist) Piers Faccini, and the songs they are creating together are an exquisite example of two disparate worlds coming together in a way that is moving and profound.

listings.description: Capital City Concerts' Capital City Concerts' second program of the season is a fall feast of music and poetry that contemplates nature, human relationships, and their interconnection. The first half of the concert features CCC Co-Director Jillian Reed in a concerto for flute and strings by Vivaldi, followed by singer-songwriter Henry Jamison in collaboration with the Skylark Quartet and bassist Nick Browne. The program culminates with renowned soprano Mary Bonhag, the Skylark Quartet, and a chorus directed by Richard Riley performing Raine Songs (2013) by Burlington-based composer Don Jamison (Henry’s father). This set of 9 songs, an arrangement of poems…

listings.description: The Green Mountain Monteverdi Ensemble of Vermont will perform the most beautiful works from the greatest Spanish composer of the early 17th Century: Tomas Luis de Victoria. The six-voice ensemble will perform Victoria's Requiem Mass, the Officium Defunctorum originally published in 1605. This work includes the Mass for the Dead and two motets, Taedet animam meam and Versa est in luctum. The second half of the concert consists of Victoria's best-loved motets for four, five and six voices including O Magnum Mysterium, O vos omnes, and Quem vidistis pastores. The exquisite harmonies of Victoria, which sometimes take surprising turns, will…

listings.description: Déjà Rêvé Actors Guild presents: Venus in Fur (( a divine love story )); a play by David Ives at the Off Center for the Dramatic Arts in Burlington, Vermont October 9 - October 17th, 2026 Vanda appears unannounced for an audition with first time director, Thomas. Thomas has spent a miserable day auditioning actresses for his stage adaptation of Venus in Furs, the scandalous Victorian novel by Leopold von Sacher-Masoch. Thomas reluctantly lets Vanda audition, only to discover that she has an inexplicable grasp of the material. As they read together, the boundaries between fantasy and reality completely dissolve…

listings.title: Lane Series: Fraser and San Miguel Fraser
listings.venue: The University of Vermont Recital Hall
listings.description: Alasdair Fraser is one of the great Scottish fiddlers and a legendary interpreter of this rich and intricate tradition. When we fell hard for his son Galen Fraser’s new duo San Miguel Fraser we thought: what if we invited them both? How delighted we were when Alasdair said he couldn’t imagine anything better than playing on a double bill with Galen and his partner, María San Miguel. Galen and María’s music fuses the sounds of María’s native Castile with the Fraser family Celtic traditions. What a celebration of musical and family ties this will be!

listings.title: Lane Series: Trio Bohémo
listings.venue: The University of Vermont Recital Hall
listings.description: Trio Bohémo was here in fall of 2024, and our chamber music audience has repeatedly asked when we will have them back. Their musicality and mastery were so impressive and they filled the hall with their enthusiasm and joy; that performance was one for the ages. Based in Prague, Trio Bohémo (Matouš Pěruška, violin; Kristina Vocetková, cello; and Jan Vojtek, piano) has swiftly emerged as a force on the international chamber music scene. Within just five years, the ensemble has garnered prestigious accolades including First Prize and the Audience Prize at the International Joseph Haydn Competition in Vienna.

listings.title: She Bravely Returns: An Immersive Women's Wellness & Writing Experience
listings.description: She Bravely Returns is an immersive women's wellness and writing experience. Why? Because caring for yourself isn't selfish—it's where everything else begins. This experience's theme is nourishing yourself from the inside out. What is this experience really about? In a world that constantly asks women to give more, do more, and carry more, She Bravely Returns offers an afternoon to turn some of that care back toward yourself. This intimate, immersive women's wellness experience brings together four local facilitators to explore different pathways to wellbeing—from listening to your own inner voice and understanding what your body is communicating to reconsidering…

listings.title: VSO at the Flynn: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
listings.description:
Celebrate Halloween with a spine-tingling orchestral matinee! From the mischievous magic of The Sorcerer’s Apprentice by Paul Dukas to eerie selections from Symphonie fantastique by Hector Berlioz and Michael Abels’ film score for NOPE, this program conjures thrills and chills. Hear music from Danny Elfman, Michael Daugherty, and Dorothy Howell—a hauntingly fun concert perfect for all ages.

The concert begins at 3:00 p.m. and is preceded at 2:00 p.m. by Musically Speaking, a free pre-concert discussion that provides entertaining insight into the evening’s program. 

Andrew Crust, conductor
